behavior: Apply accepts only an expected plan SHA-256 as review identity; no caller-supplied root, filesystem operations, authority records, or byte readers are accepted.
At dispatch the adapter snapshots fixed repository-contained source and authority refs, rebuilds the plan from that snapshot, and rejects any plan fingerprint mismatch or current blocker.
The effect path delegates only fixed-root ordered two-target writes to the shared quality CAS, which independently rechecks current fixed records and exact source bytes.
Sibling Lifecycle references resolve through fixed sibling paths with symlink components rejected.

negativeCoverage: A preflight assembled from cached peer, source-owner decision, and apply authorization is rejected when the fixed peer changes before dispatch.
A preflight is rejected when the fixed apply-authorization record is deleted before dispatch.
Target source bytes remain unchanged on rejected dispatch.

frozenProducerPinState.note: The v1 freeze remains immutable and historical. This receipt binds the current implementation bytes without implying that the old producer pins are current.
